theorem.statement: IF ABC_SELECTED_CONTEXT_COVER IS COMPLETE UNDER THE EXACT FROZEN SEMANTICS OF EACH OF THE FOUR ROWS ABOVE, THEN ALL FOUR ROWS HOLD AS CONSEQUENCES OF ABC AND NEED NOT APPEAR AS INDEPENDENT TERMINAL CONJUNCTS.
proof: ABC_GLOBAL_CLOSURE_PLACES_THAT_CONTEXT_IN_A_SELECTED_CELL_OR REQUIRES A SOUND PROOF IT IS NOT TARGET_OCCUPIED.
FOR AN OCCUPIED CELL ABC BINDS TARGET_RELATIVE ADEQUACY/DISTRIBUTIONAL DOMINANCE UNDER COMPLETE LOAD_BEARING EVALUATORS AND HARD_CONSTRAINT PRESERVATION.
THE ROW'S FROZEN ACCEPTANCE SEMANTICS ARE BY PREMISE INCLUDED IN THOSE EVALUATORS/HARD_CONSTRAINTS.
THEREFORE THE SELECTED BRAIN ROUTE IS NONINFERIOR ON THE ROW'S LOAD_BEARING SEMANTICS FOR EVERY COVERED TARGET CONTEXT.
THE SEPARATE ROW IS THUS AN ABC REFINEMENT/EVIDENCE OBLIGATION, NOT AN ADDITIONAL LOGICALLY INDEPENDENT TERMINAL CONJUNCT.
theorem.necessity_boundary: ABSORPTION FAILS IF THE EXACT FROZEN ROW SEMANTICS ARE NOT INCLUDED IN ABC. THE REPAIR MUST FAIL CLOSED BY REOPENING THE ROW OR ABC COMPLETENESS.
